answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 42800 Country: Bangladesh Title: Family issue Question: I have married 4 years before. But recently I came to know that my wife is not their own daughter. I mean she has blood connection with her mother, not her father according to the blood grouping test. What should I do in terms of Quran and Sunnah. Should I continue my life with my wife or give her release from the knot. Please give me valid and suggestions. Answer ID: 42800 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 12/12/M=1434) You need not investigate and have doubt about the linage of your wife after four years of the marriage. However, if supposedly the blood relation of wife is not established with her father then too it shall have no effect on your nikah. Moreover a medical test is not Shariah evidence. You should live with your wife and maintain good relationship with her. You should not have any kind of doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
